scope: Sample-level review of KdConv training material only; no inference about overall dataset quality.

methodology.sampling: Python random.Random(340021), one shared generator; random.sample(range(len(data)), 8), in film, music, travel order; without replacement within each domain. Indices are zero-based, listed in draw order.
methodology.inspection: Read every message of all 24 sampled dialogues, including record and message field structure; reviewed examples of knowledge attributes and scanned sampled attributes and messages for prompt-related markers. Turns in reasons are zero-based. No external factual verification was performed.
methodology.role_policy: Messages have no role field. For review only, even turns are tentatively treated as the first participant and odd turns as the second; this is not evidence of true roles. Apparent same-speaker continuations are flagged; all role mappings require validation.
methodology.labels: naturalness is mixed or low; persona marks a second-participant first-person preference, experience, identity or planned action that would be invented if assigned to an assistant; time_sensitive marks potentially changing or relative claims, not proven falsehood; identifiers marks public venue contacts/addresses or potentially sensitive personal details, not proof of private data; prompt_inclusion records visible evidence only.
methodology.privacy: Venue names, phone numbers and addresses appear as apparently public business information; actor family details and blood type warrant context-sensitive review. No direct private individual contact was identified in sampled message text.
methodology.limits: Attributes are knowledge metadata, not reliable role annotations. Keyword scans do not prove absence of hidden instructions, personal data, or prior prompts. No dev or test files were inspected. CPU only.

decision: Conditional, curated bounded-training candidate only; do not ingest these sampled dialogues wholesale. Validate or reconstruct participant roles; remove or rewrite unsupported assistant persona and shared-memory claims, discourage insults and unsupported lookup claims, review private or sensitive details, and date, verify or exclude mutable factual claims and venue contacts. Exclude uncertain turns or dialogues when these conditions cannot be met. This small sample cannot establish corpus-wide quality, safety, factual accuracy, provenance of individual assertions, or absence of prompt leakage.
